events_volunteer_settings.name: events_volunteer_settings
events_volunteer_settings.value: "events"."volunteer_target_count" >= 0 and "events"."volunteer_max_hours" between 0 and 24 and "events"."volunteer_min_rest_minutes" between 0 and 1440

membership_plans_period.name: membership_plans_period
membership_plans_period.value: ("membership_plans"."period_kind" = 'fixed' and "membership_plans"."valid_from" is not null and "membership_plans"."valid_until" is not null and "membership_plans"."valid_until" > "membership_plans"."valid_from") or ("membership_plans"."period_kind" = 'rolling' and "membership_plans"."duration_months" between 1 and 60)

memberships_validity.name: memberships_validity
memberships_validity.value: "memberships"."valid_from" is null or "memberships"."valid_until" is null or "memberships"."valid_until" > "memberships"."valid_from"

memberships_active_has_validity.name: memberships_active_has_validity
memberships_active_has_validity.value: "memberships"."status" not in ('active','suspended','expired') or ("memberships"."valid_from" is not null and "memberships"."valid_until" is not null)

ticket_types_sales_window.name: ticket_types_sales_window
ticket_types_sales_window.value: "ticket_types"."sales_start_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" > "ticket_types"."sales_start_at"
